title: Jejune Crispy Saudi Provola Tagine
description: A pungent and cozy Saudi-Arabian dish featuring crispy provola cheese, inspired by traditional tagine recipes.
instructions: Preheat your sous vide machine to 160°F (71°C).
Wrap the provolone cheese in parchment paper and place it in the sous vide machine for 1 hour.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent and caramelized.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Remove the provolone cheese from the sous vide machine and slice it into thin rounds.
Add the sliced provolone cheese to the pan and cook until it is crispy and golden brown.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
